title: Demo Ski Rental Package for Salt Lake City - Cottonwood Resort
includes: Park City or Deer Valley Shop Pick-Up (not included)
Damage insurance: $3 - $4 based on item (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Adult skiers must have a shoe size 7 and up to be accommodated with this package
policies: You are permitted to pick up your skis the night before you ski after 4pm, so you can enjoy a full day on the slopes. You have until 10:00 am the day after your final ski day to return the gear.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Demo Ski Package - the latest and greatest available in ski equipment for the season. Varied shapes, sizes, and colors to please the most advanced skiers and make a novice look like a pro. A full-day rental, plus time to relax and return the gear.
